title: Red lentil and kale soup with smoked paprika

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or cupboard staple: lentils, tinned tomatoes, stock, vegetables and spices.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one large pan, a knife and a board, and the technique is simple simmering.

works.reason: 200g red lentils to 1.2 litres of stock with a tin of tomatoes makes a properly thick soup for four, and the timings, spicing and lemon finish are sound.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is fair for chopping an onion, two carrots and garlic and stripping the kale, and the steps add up to roughly the 30 minutes of cooking printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming lentil soup with 200g of shredded kale suits a cold late-January lunch, and the kale is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lentils, vegetables and kale make a filling, wholesome lunch that a family would happily eat again.
